svg.title: Breadboard layout for the ESP32-S3 phygital sensor hub
svg.desc: Two half-size breadboards joined with their power rails removed. The ESP32-S3 straddles the seam. A 5V battery module powers the rails, and the S3 takes its power from the 5V rail through its 5V pin (row 24). Radars and mic connect with jumpers on the left board; the amp plugs into the right board.
svg.text: Not to scale. Push the S3 in across the seam wherever its pins fit; what matters is the row each wire goes in.
Every hole in a half-row (a–e or f–j) is connected, so any free hole in a pin's half-row works.
